capabilities: open weekly todo notes as an editable Monday-Sunday calendar
plan weekly focus items as draggable, collapsible cards below the calendar
create, drag, resize, complete and edit timed tasks in the calendar view
route past weeks to a 001-Past folder and future weeks to 002-Future
sync the current week's tasks to an existing iCloud-backed Apple Calendar on macOS
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Apple Calendar export is macOS desktop only; the calendar view itself works on mobile.
intentEvidence: Weekly Todo Calendar is based on the open-source Obsidian Day Planner.
problem: Obsidian weekly todo notes are plain Markdown with no calendar view for scheduling and dragging timed tasks across a week.

relations.evidence: Weekly Todo Calendar is based on the open-source Obsidian Day Planner.
Sync a weekly note to an existing Apple Calendar on macOS.
Display tasks from daily notes, Obsidian Tasks dates, and ICS calendars.

summary: Calendar plugin that turns weekly Markdown todo notes into an editable Monday-Sunday calendar, with optional Apple Calendar sync on macOS.
